name: Kurokawa Kiyoka
source:
Her only sexual experience is with Takeshi and marital relations are cooling down.

Her interest in her husband as a member of the opposite sex is also waning, she does not dislike him necessarily.

She is gentle, calm, and demure.

From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apadash/aptd_025.html]official site[/url]]
